card.name: Coco
card.tagline: Afro-Brazilian Northeastern stomping song-dance (coco de roda).
card.profile: Coco is an African-influenced musical rhythm and dance from northeastern Brazil, especially Alagoas and Paraiba, performed in a circle (coco de roda) with call-and-response singing and stomping (often in wooden clogs). Instruments include ganza, surdo, pandeiro and triangle. Earliest cocos were work songs of Afro-Brazilians, including at Palmares, sung while breaking coconuts, and tied to communal house-building on clay floors (English Wikipedia; Encyclopedia.com).
card.insight: Coco is also called embolada and appears under many regional names (coco de ganza, coco de zambe); Encyclopedia.com traces its earliest forms to Afro-Brazilian work songs of Palmares.
